mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM interview_sessions WHERE status IN ('planning', 'in_progress', 'report_generating')
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS metric_date, COUNT(1) AS metric_value FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS metric_date, COUNT(1) AS metric_value FROM interview_sessions WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS metric_date, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(request_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(response_tokens, 0)), 0) AS metric_value FROM ai_invocation_logs WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC

SELECT normalized_model_provider AS model_provider, normalized_model_name AS model_name, COUNT(1) AS request_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count, CAST(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN latency_ms IS NOT NULL THEN latency_ms END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS avg_latency_ms FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(model_provider), ''), 'unknown') AS normalized_model_provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(model_name), ''), 'unknown') AS normalized_model_name, success, latency_ms FROM ai_invocation_logs WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} ) recent_logs GROUP BY normalized_model_provider, normalized_model_name ORDER BY request_count DESC, normalized_model_provider ASC, normalized_model_name ASC

SELECT normalized_model_provider AS model_provider, normalized_model_name AS model_name, latency_ms FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(model_provider), ''), 'unknown') AS normalized_model_provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(model_name), ''), 'unknown') AS normalized_model_name, latency_ms FROM ai_invocation_logs WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ) recent_logs ORDER BY normalized_model_provider ASC, normalized_model_name ASC, latency_ms ASC

SELECT prompt_code, SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{recentStart} AND created_at < #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calls_last_24_hours, MAX(created_at) AS last_used_at FROM ai_invocation_logs WHERE created_at < #{end} GROUP BY prompt_code ORDER BY prompt_code ASC
